shortDescription: Manages Global Resiliency Group on the Central Manager.

options.name: dns_listener_name
options.description: Specifies the name of the DNS listener.

options.name: dns_listener_port
options.description: Specifies the port number of the DNS listener.

options.name: instances
options.description: Specifies the BIG-IP Next instances of the global resiliency group.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the global resiliency group.

options.name: protocols
options.description: Specifies the protocols to be used.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the global resiliency group is created/renewed on the Central Manager. When C(absent), ensures the global resiliency group is removed from the the Central Manager.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the amount of time to wait for the global resiliency group to be created or updated. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
